USER: # Public Summary — Weft

## What Weft is

Weft is an archive-first context and knowledge infrastructure project for AI-assisted workflows.

It is designed to turn temporary AI interactions, workflow outputs, and project decisions into structured, searchable, project-linked records that can be retrieved later to support continuity across sessions, tools, and models.

Weft is not a chatbot, Notion template, or Make tutorial. It is a system architecture project focused on persistent context, deterministic workflow behavior, and controlled knowledge capture.

## Problem it solves

AI-assisted work often breaks down when useful context remains trapped inside temporary conversations, disconnected notes, or tool-specific outputs.

This creates recurring problems:

* important decisions are hard to find later
* context must be manually reconstructed
* project continuity depends on memory or copy-paste
